Question: When updating vendor details as an individual with Singpass, what happens if the government database connectivity fails?
Answer: - When updating vendor details as an individual with Singpass, if the government database connectivity fails, the name field will be available for updating. However, if you choose not to do the manual update, your name will be retrieved from MyInfo when the connectivity is restored. This is described in the “2. View/ Update Vendor Record Details” section (Individual with Singpass) on the provided page. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 21]

Question: During vendor record creation, where is the vendor name sourced from for an individual with Singpass?
Answer: - The vendor name for individuals with Singpass is retrieved from the government database MyInfo and is not editable. This is shown in the “1. Create Vendor Record (Individuals with Singpass)” section, where it states the name is auto-populated from the government database – MyInfo and is not editable. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 6]

Question: What is the difference between how the Official Name and Vendor Name fields are populated for a local company?
Answer: - For Local Companies, the Official name is registered and retrieved from the government database (Enterprise Data Hub) and is displayed as “Official name” while the Vendor Name field is populated from the official name but limited to the first 80 characters. In short: Official name comes from the government database; Vendor Name is auto-populated from that official name and is not editable beyond the first 80 characters. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 6]

Question: Under what three conditions will a vendor record be made inactive?
Answer:
- A vendor record will be made inactive if:
  - There was no activity for more than 2 years; or
  - There was a failed Interbank GIRO (IBG) payment to your bank account; or
  - You or your client agency has requested the vendor record inactivation. [Document: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 36]

Question: What must an unapproved vendor ensure before their record can be approved?
Answer:
- An unapproved vendor must ensure that the following are updated correctly before their record can be approved:
  - The vendor record “Name” and “Bank details” are updated correctly in Vendors@gov.
  - The correct login option is selected (for more information, refer to the Login and Registration User Guide). [Document: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 36]

Question: What can a vendor do to reactivate an inactive vendor record?
Answer: - To reactivate an inactive vendor record, you can click on the “Reactivate” button upon successful login. After reactivation, you may update your vendor record details in the portal. [Document: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 36]

Question: What are the three authorisation clauses a new vendor agrees to when creating a vendor record?
Answer:
- The three authorisation clauses are listed under the “Authorisation” section on the Create Vendor Record page:
  - Clause 1: I/We hereby authorise the Government and Statutory Boards to credit payments due to me/us to the stated account. Amounts so credited would constitute valid discharge of obligations due to me/us.
  - Clause 2: This authorisation shall continue to be in force until I/We have notifi ed you in writing.
  - Clause 3: I/We hereby request and authorise the Government and Statutary Boards to obtain confirmation/verification of information relating to me/us and/or to my/her accounts from/with the bank where the Account is maintained as stated in the form.
Source: [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 4]

Question: Can a foreign individual without Singpass update their vendor record details directly on Vendors@Gov?
Answer:
Answer: No. A foreign individual without Singpass cannot update their vendor details directly on Vendors@Gov.

Evidence:
- The page “Why am I unable to update my vendor details?” states under the third bullet: “You are a foreign individual who do not have Singpass. Update of vendor record details is not available for foreign individual…” [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 34].
